title: Elenchos suppressions
description: Suppressions file of a consumer: the identities of tolerated findings, each with its justification. Each identity is a canonical identity string of the profile key `elenchos/v1`, and occurs at most once; the schema cannot express canonicity, which the gate checks.

_schema.description: Identifier of the suppressions format, first key of the file; format 1 holds identities of the profile key `elenchos/v1`.

identity.description: Canonical identity string of the suppressed finding.

justification.description: Reason for which the finding is tolerated.

date.description: ISO 8601 date on which the entry was written.
